meta.title: WinterGateIC Entity Intelligence
meta.scope: Group-level entity monitoring. No usernames, account IDs, invite links, victim data, or private identifiers.
meta.privacy: No target list. Areas are platforms/surfaces, not people. Handles are leads, not identities.
meta.learning_model: Rule-based adaptive scoring from confidence, source density, tactical indicators, area footprint, and evolution timeline. Not a predictive AI model and not a claim of future certainty.

entities.name: UTTP / UTube Troll Police
entities.summary: Decentralised harassment brand originating in 2011; tactics include raids, mass reporting, doxxing threats, shock content, and youth-facing recruitment. No single command chain is established.
entities.current_state: Community documentation describes UTTP as heavily reduced (‘complete DNB’/almost no members) while splinters and adjacent NVE networks continue. Brand remains reusable.

evolution.event: Leadership and faction changes; raids and harassment expand
Escalation toward account takeover, DoS, larger raids
Gacha Life targeting, personal-information theft, extortion reported
Nu-UTTP/UTTP Empire era; more extreme content and NVE overlap alleged
764 recruitment/infiltration into UTTP high command alleged
Circusfall revival, faction split, AFR splinter, community ‘DNB’ assessment

not_supported: UTTP is a designated terrorist entity

learning.next_likely: smaller rebrands and migration to private/soycord spaces
learning.basis: decentralised brand, fluid membership, platform churn, documented overlap

entities.name: UTTP Empire / Nu-UTTP
entities.summary: Later UTTP faction associated with more extreme content, CSAM/gore spam allegations, and NVE overlap. Tied to ‘Emperor of Anime Sucks’ / Hyper Bat Mapping in community records.
entities.current_state: Lineage associated with extreme-content era and subsequent 2026 revival claims.

evolution.event: Nu-UTTP/UTTP Empire era; mass CSAM/gore spam and extremist recruitment alleged
Circusfall revival attributed to returning figures

not_supported: UTTP Empire is a formal organisation with verified command

learning.basis: extreme-content era, faction splits, community reports

entities.name: Circusfall faction
entities.summary: Early-2026 UTTP revival associated with shock/animal-gore spam on X. Split with OfficerSlappy faction; self-proclaimed unification claims.
entities.current_state: Community-reported revival and split; not independently verified.

evolution.event: Civil war split with OfficerSlappy faction reported
Soul Reaver/Warlock/Irin911 reported takeover and renunciation of gore spam

learning.next_likely: rebrand or absorption into another faction

entities.name: OfficerSlappy faction / UTTP Forum
entities.summary: UTTP Forum and website lineage; mention-spam campaigns; Deltafall renamed Rockstarfall; reported copyright-leak partnerships.
not_supported: OfficerSlappy faction is a unified command

learning.basis: forum lineage, spam campaigns, platform bans

entities.name: Anti-Fandom Resistance (AFR)
entities.summary: Splinter from the Circusfall faction after infighting; antifandom.org reported shut down 2026-08-07; continues in decentralized soycord/COM spaces.
entities.current_state: Reported forum shutdown and server nuke; decentralized after.

evolution.event: AFR splinter forms from Circusfall faction
antifandom.org reported shut down; server nuked

entities.name: Bn0r Empire
entities.summary: Subgroup tied to Bn0r/Chizur; mention-spam ecosystem and subgroup branding.
not_supported: Bn0r Empire is a stable organisation

entities.name: Reddit Defence Force (RDF)
entities.summary: Reddit-facing UTTP revival with mention spam; RDFPARTY splinter. Leadership claims are self-reported.

entities.name: Degeneracy Police Order State (DPOS)
entities.summary: Structured, police-state-themed Discord network with Empire/Task Force/ISA HQ/log units. Bridges UTTP raid culture to 764/Com-style grooming, blackmail, and shock content. Not a 764 unit and no merger is established.
entities.current_state: Rotating micro-servers and rebrand attempts reported; no independent census.

evolution.event: DPOS emerges as hardcore UTTP offshoot
Escalation into doxxing, swatting threats, shock spam, grooming/blackmail allegations
Rotating micro-servers and rebrand attempts reported

learning.basis: structured server model, 764 tactical overlap, platform pressure

entities.summary: Decentralised nihilistic violent extremist network in the Com ecosystem. Designated in Canada (2025). Tactical overlap with UTTP/DPOS; not a UTTP command.

entities.name: Order of Nine Angles (O9A / ONA)
entities.summary: Decentralised, leaderless militant-accelerationist network. New Zealand designated O9A/ONA in 2025. 764 is listed as a nexion; nexions are operationally independent.
not_supported: O9A is a single organisation with a leader

entities.name: Harm Nation
entities.summary: Documented 764 offshoot focused on normalising self-injurious behaviour among youth.
entities.current_state: Fluid network; not a single organisation.
not_supported: Harm Nation is a stable organisation

entities.name: Spawnism
entities.summary: Self-harm/recruitment cult with alleged UTTP/DPOS crossover. Community and leak material, not independent confirmation.
entities.current_state: Alleged crossover with DPOS/UTTP; no command confirmed.

evolution.event: Spawnism emerges and is linked to UTTP/DPOS in community/leak material

entities.name: Anti-UTTP / AUTTP
entities.summary: Loose opposition coalition to UTTP, not a single organisation.

entities.name: FPE (Fundamental Paper Education) ecosystem
entities.summary: Youth-heavy fandom ecosystem targeted by UTTP-linked activity. WIC documents an FPE incursion; WIC is not an FPE partner and does not govern the fandom.
entities.current_state: Target ecosystem; WIC defence/reporting role only.

entities.name: FPE-Police
entities.summary: FPE-Police branding within the FPE ecosystem. Role-play/AU, not an official police force. No verified member list.
entities.current_state: Branding used; no formal organisation confirmed.
not_supported: FPE-Police is an official police force

entities.name: TNM / The Militia
entities.summary: Adjacent network with individual crossover and 2025 investigation material. Presence in the archive is documentation/lead, not proof of command.
Adjacent network represented by archive/export material. Command links are unproven.

entities.name: Imperium of Enclave / UETR-GSR
entities.summary: Adjacent network represented by UID lists and crossover. Command links are unproven.

entities.name: SPWN / Spawnism
entities.summary: Placeholder/lead folder. Do not overstate.

entities.name: 11th Street
entities.summary: Explicitly marked unverified lead.

entities.name: KuKluxTrollKlan (KKTK)
entities.summary: Early UTTP Google+ era group (2017).

entities.name: YouTube Farm Gang Army (YFGA)
entities.summary: Gachafall-era group (2020-2021).

entities.name: VideoGameCartoonPolice (VGCP)
entities.summary: Oldest known UTTP splinter; anti-UTTP; disbanded for over a decade.

entities.name: Anti Fandom Front (AFF)
entities.summary: Anti-fandom front distinct from AFR; community-reported.

entities.name: TND / The Group That Destroyed FPE
entities.summary: FPE conflict group in the registry; no independent verification.

entities.name: Zeta
entities.summary: Reported UTTP ally in the registry; no independent verification.

entities.name: YouTube Troll Destroyers
entities.summary: Primary UTTP opposition in the registry.
not_supported: YouTube Troll Destroyers is a formal organisation

entities.name: 09A Cult (legacy archive label)
entities.summary: Legacy archive label for O9A-adjacent material. Not a headquarters or proven parent; 09A is an alternate spelling.

evolution.event: Label corrected as legacy archive context

claims.basis: No DPOS designation located.

claims.claim: The 2026 UTTP offshoot layer (Circusfall, OfficerSlappy/UTTP Forum, AFR, Bn0r Empire, RDF/RDFPARTY) is community-reported and not independently verified.
claims.basis: Soyjak Wiki 2026-11-18; WIC tracking register.

claims.claim: No independent census of current UTTP/offshoot membership exists.
claims.basis: Absence of independent count; community claims only.

claims.claim: '6 GB of the 10 GB total; 4 GB remaining'
claims.basis: Superseded release wording; the public release is 6 GB.

claims.claim: 'UTTP is a designated terrorist entity'
claims.basis: No designation instrument naming UTTP was located. 764 and O9A are designated.

claims.claim: 'The FBI classified 764 as a Tier 1 terrorist threat'
claims.basis: No primary FBI document using the 'Tier 1' label was located.

claims.claim: 'O9A/09A is the parent entity and 764 is its operational arm'
claims.basis: The NZ statement lists 764 as an O9A nexion, but nexions are operationally independent; no parent/command relationship is established.

claims.claim: 'O9A commands 764' / '764 = O9A'
claims.basis: O9A nexions are operationally independent; 764 is a distinct network.

claims.claim: 'UTTP is an operational arm of 764' / 'UTTP merged with 764'
claims.basis: No command, merger, shared leadership, or tasking record located; both networks are decentralised.

claims.claim: '764 infiltrated UTTP as an organisation'
claims.basis: The infiltration described by Sparx is by 'bad actors' in 2019-2021 and is O9A-adjacent; 764 emerged in 2021.

claims.claim: 'Profiles: 823'
claims.basis: The raw file contains 823 rows, not 823 profiles; many are search, login, error, or duplicate pages.

claims.claim: '760 primary detections'
claims.basis: The raw CSV has 823 rows (761 exact, 62 similarity); 760 is the number of unique platform labels.

claims.claim: '48 platform-name entries'
claims.basis: The supplied platform-name list contains 47 variants, which normalize to 37 keys.

claims.claim: '22 validated handles/findings'
claims.basis: The 22 are structural candidates, not ownership-confirmed accounts; 0 were ownership-verified in the 2026-11-19 pass.

claims.claim: 'All content is legal/public' / 'No private data is exposed'
claims.basis: Absolute wording is not supportable; legality is jurisdiction-dependent and historical captures contain identifiers.

claims.claim: '09A Cult is O9A's headquarters / the root of the hierarchy'
claims.basis: '09A Cult' is a legacy archive label; no headquarters is established.

claims.claim: '764 is UTTP's parent ecosystem'
claims.basis: 764 is a designated, decentralised network; it is not a proven parent of UTTP.

claims.claim: 'The FPE operation caused UTTP to retreat / independently proved a 764 command link'
claims.basis: WIC self-authored account; causality and independent validation are not established.

claims.claim: '764 operatives infiltrated UTTP high command' / 'merger mid-to-late 2025'
claims.basis: WIC records describe alleged recruitment/overlap; no primary command, merger, or tasking record located.

claims.claim: 'DPOS is a 764-derived network — 100% confirmed'
claims.basis: Tactical/ideological overlap is supported; derivation/command is not. WIC language overstates the evidence.

claims.claim: 'DPOS is a documented federal target'
claims.basis: No primary federal case, indictment, or designation naming DPOS was located.

claims.claim: '1,750+ linked accounts'
claims.basis: third-party/DTAD count is not independently verified; counting method and unique-account threshold are not published.

claims.claim: 'The DPOS lead is 90% likely a 764 member/affiliate'
claims.basis: Behavioural/tactical overlap is not membership proof; the 90% figure has no published method.

claims.claim: 'UNIPOL Level 3 designation'
claims.basis: No UNIPOL/agency instrument was located.

claims.claim: 'DPOS is UTTP' / 'DPOS is a 764 unit'
claims.basis: DPOS is an offshoot/overlap node, not identical to UTTP or 764.

rules: Stage is derived from the documented evolution timeline, not inferred from a single event.
Risk score is a weighted sum of confidence, source density, tactical indicators, area footprint, and recency.
A high risk score means 'more evidence and more severe harm indicators'; it is not a probability of future violence.
Morphology predictions are assessments, not facts: a fragmented brand is likely to rebrand, migrate, or splinter.
No individual identity, membership, or command relationship is inferred from a handle, nickname, or group name.

morphology.prediction: influence through texts and autonomous nexions
